scenes.text: Keep a simple growth record and explain sustainable farming
Crop: a plant grown to be eaten or sold. Seedling: a young plant that has begun to grow.
Transplanting: moving a young plant carefully into a new growing place. Compost: decayed organic matter that improves soil. Farm record: notes about plant growth, costs or harvests.
Grow one seed safely in a reused container and record its changes for ten days.
